inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL three-way NATURAL JOIN chain joins successive relations through their shared column names.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored shipment report. Manifest, package, and event tables share shipment_id and hub_code, so each NATURAL JOIN must enforce both shared columns; mismatched hubs and an unlisted shipment verify that the chain does not collapse to a single-key join.

fixture_notes: Shipment 101 matches all three tables on shipment_id and hub_code. Shipment 102 has a package with the wrong hub, and shipment 103 has no package, so only shipment 101 appears.
determinism_notes: Shipment IDs and event IDs are fixed and the report is ordered by both. There are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_manifest (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, hub_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, route_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, customer_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE shipment_packages (package_id INT PRIMARY KEY, shipment_id INT NOT NULL, hub_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, package_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE shipment_events (event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, shipment_id INT NOT NULL, hub_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, event_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT shipment_id, hub_code, route_code, package_label, event_id, event_kind FROM shipment_manifest NATURAL JOIN shipment_packages NATURAL JOIN shipment_events ORDER BY shipment_id, event_id

checks.sql: SELECT shipment_id, hub_code, route_code, customer_name FROM shipment_manifest ORDER BY shipment_id
SELECT package_id, shipment_id, hub_code, package_label FROM shipment_packages ORDER BY package_id
SELECT event_id, shipment_id, hub_code, event_kind FROM shipment_events ORDER BY event_id
